verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a real bulk capability: the v2 Product Catalog Import API ingests whole product, inventory, and pricing catalogs as CSV files (upsert or replace, up to 4 GB). Results come back through terminal webhooks and a per-row error CSV. That support is confined to Agentic Commerce Suite catalogs in listed regions, and 'bulk-fulfill' relies on a List endpoint rather than a true batch-write operation. missing for 10: general-purpose batch write/update across core objects (customers, subscriptions, refunds, invoices), bulk actions through MCP or CLI, documentation of bulk operations outside product catalogs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Agentic Commerce Suite ingests full product catalogs as bulk CSV imports via the v2 Product Catalog Import API
The maximum file size is 4 GB
Sellers can bulk-fulfill via the List CheckoutSessions endpoint
